title: HB189 (2018 Regular): AN ACT relating to the regulation of firearms and ammunition.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Draft, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/18RS/HB189/bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 1685608))
provenance.note: Draft print (18 RS BR 911); no passage vote. Subsections (6) and (7) are new; the only marked change is the renumbering (8)[(7)]. Subsection (1) preemption is unchanged but now "Except as provided in subsection (6)".

operative_text:
Section 1 (KRS 65.870): (6) A city of the first class or home rule class, county, urban-county government, charter county, consolidated local government, or unified local government may enact legislation or policies that: (a) Require the sale of firearms or ammunitions within their territory or jurisdiction be transacted using responsible business practices; (b) Require firearm owners who work or reside within the territory or jurisdiction to report any lost or stolen firearm to local law enforcement within a prescribed amount of time following discovery of the loss or theft of the firearm; or (c) Provide funding for firearm violence intervention programs within the territory or jurisdiction.
Section 1 (KRS 65.870): (7) A violation of this section by a public servant shall be a violation of either KRS 522.020 or 522.030, depending on the circumstances of the violation.
